objectives.description: Add manifest-driven per-category parity + content-hash verification in verify.lua, driven by loader.CATEGORY_DESCRIPTORS, covering the 7 previously-uncovered categories (commands, scripts, hooks, docs, templates, systemd, root_files) plus a hash-equality overlay on the 4 already-covered categories (agents, skills, rules, context)
objectives.note: walk_category_leaves + verify_manifest_category added, driven by loader.CATEGORY_DESCRIPTORS. Fixed a copy-engine trailing-newline false positive by hashing vim.fn.readfile-joined content instead of raw bytes. Verified: fresh scratch deploy is zero-findings across all 11 categories; deliberate staling of skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md is caught and clears on redeploy.

objectives.description: Wire the new verification into verify-deploy.sh as an additive gate5, routing findings through the existing FINDINGS_LIST accumulator
objectives.note: gate5 runs manager.verify_all headlessly and emits FINDING gate5 lines. Fixed an OSC7-escape-sequence parsing bug (anchored grep '^VERIFY_FINDING' silently matched nothing) by switching to unanchored grep, mirroring deploy-headless.sh's own DEPLOY_COUNT= extraction pattern. Verified: clean deploy -> gate5 PASS; deliberately-staled deploy -> gate5 FAIL with the correct FINDING gate5 line; gates 1-4 narrative output unchanged before/after.

approaches_tried.approach: Raw byte-for-byte sha256 hash of file content
approaches_tried.reason: False positive on context/formats/frontmatter.md (and any other source file lacking a final trailing newline) because loader.lua's copy engine reads/writes via vim.fn.readfile/writefile line-array semantics, which always appends a trailing newline on write. Fixed by hashing readfile-joined content instead.

approaches_tried.approach: Anchored grep '^VERIFY_FINDING ' to extract findings from headless nvim stdout in verify-deploy.sh
approaches_tried.reason: nvim --headless in this environment prepends an OSC7 cwd-reporting terminal escape sequence to the first stdout line with no newline separator, defeating the start-of-line anchor. Fixed by switching to unanchored grep, matching deploy-headless.sh's existing DEPLOY_COUNT= extraction convention.

deviations.description: Plan's Scope Hypothesis and task list said 6 uncovered categories (scripts, hooks, docs, templates, systemd, root_files)
deviations.reason: jq -r '.provides | keys[]' lists 11 categories; 4 were already covered (agents, skills, rules, context) before this phase, leaving 7 uncovered, not 6 -- commands (18 entries) was omitted from the plan's prose enumeration. Because verification is driven generically from loader.CATEGORY_DESCRIPTORS rather than a hand-typed list, commands required no extra implementation work, just recognizing it belonged in the uncovered_categories array.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — category-count reconciliation, see plan Phase 7 notes)*
